messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts: one item per fact, without article numbers or comments inside the items. Facts filed under the same
  article, annex part or numbered point belong together: a part's members are the facts filed under its points.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which category does a safety component with self-evolving behaviour based on machine learning fall under?

Facts:
[0] safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour — listedIn — Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour (annex I part A point 5) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 5]
[1] machinery with embedded self-evolving ML systems ensuring safety functions — listedIn — 6. (annex I, part A, point 6) [condition: in respect only of those systems] [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 6]
[2] self-evolving machinery — requiresMeasure — adapting machinery or a related product (adapting machinery or a related product) [condition: where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.6]
[3] Autonomous mobile machinery — definedAs — has an autonomous mode (has an autonomous mode) [condition: all essential safety functions ensured without permanent interaction of an operator] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[4] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — devices intended to detect any human, domestic animal or any other obstacle in its vicinity (devices intended to detect any human, domestic animal or any other obstacle in its vicinity) [condition: where those obstacles could give rise to a risk to the health and safety of persons or domestic animals or to the safe operation of the machinery or related product] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[5] safety component — definedAs — ‘safety component’ means a physical or digital component (‘safety component’ means a physical or digital component) [condition: but which is not necessary in order for that product to function or for which normal components may be substituted in order for that product to function] [REG, Art. 3(3)]
[6] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — an enclosed zone fitted with a peripheral protection system comprising guards or protective devices (an enclosed zone fitted with a peripheral protection system comprising guards or protective devices) [condition: with one or both where necessary according to the risk assessment] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[7] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode (supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode) [condition: Where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 3.2.4]
[8] 2.3(d) non-fully automated machine — addressesRisk — risk of accidental injury (risk of accidental injury) [condition: where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine] [DIR, Annex I, 2.3]
[9] category of machinery or related product — listedIn — Annex I, Part A (annex i, part a) [condition: if, according to the assessment referred to in paragraph 4, and taking into account the available information, it presents a serious inherent potential risk, and one or more of the following conditions is fulfilled] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[10] control system — requiresMeasure — designed to perform the safety functions by itself (designed to perform the safety functions by itself) [condition: For autonomous mobile machinery or related product; even when actions are ordered by using a remote supervisory function] [REG, Annex III, 3.3]
[11] control systems for pedestrian-controlled machinery — addressesRisk — inadvertent movement of the machinery towards the driver (inadvertent movement of the machinery towards the driver) [REG, Annex III, 3.3.4]
[12] machinery with collision risk — requiresMeasure — fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided (fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided) [condition: where several fixed or rail-mounted machines can be manoeuvred simultaneously in the same place, with risks of collision] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.6]
[13] non-fully automated machinery with incorporated tool — addressesRisk — risk of accidental injury (risk of accidental injury) [condition: where the tool is incorporated into non-fully automated machinery or a related product] [REG, Annex III, 2.3]
[14] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) (conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[15] essential requirement 1.7.1.2 (warning devices) — addressesRisk — a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery (a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery) [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.1.2]
[16] remote-controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately (devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately) [condition: if the driver loses control, if it receives a stop signal, if a fault is detected in a safety-related part of the system, if no validation signal is detected within a specified time] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.3]
[17] Machinery or related products presenting risks due to their mobility — definedAs — operatedwithout being moved (operatedwithout being moved) [condition: machinery operated without being moved but which may be equipped to be moved more easily] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[18] autonomous mobile machinery or related products — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [REG, Annex III, 3.6.3.3]
[19] Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility — definedAs — Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility (machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility) [DIR, Annex I, 3.1.1]
[20] safety component — definedAs — means a component (means a component) [condition: which is independently placed on the market] [DIR, Art. 2]
[21] Machinery or related products presenting risks due to their mobility — definedAs — requires either mobility while working (requires either mobility while working) [condition: the operation requires mobility while working, or continuous or semi continuous movement between fixed working locations] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[22] automatic-charging batteries of mobile machinery — addressesRisk — hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1 (hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1) [condition: when the machinery or related product moves autonomously to the charging station] [REG, Annex III, 3.5.1]
[23] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) (conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[24] indicative list of safety components — listedIn — Annex II (annex II) [condition: in the light of technical progress and knowledge or new scientific evidence] [REG, Art. 7(2)]
[25] control systems, safety and reliability — addressesRisk — hazardous situations (hazardous situations) [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.1]
[26] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[27] 1.3.7 moving parts — requiresMeasure — guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.7]
[28] movement of machinery depending on safe positioning of parts — requiresMeasure — movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning (movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning) [condition: where it does not give rise to other risks] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.2]
[29] starting in automatic mode — addressesRisk — hazardous situation (hazardous situation) [condition: provided this does not lead to a hazardous situation] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.3]
[30] warning devices — requiresMeasure — appropriate acoustic or light signal (appropriate acoustic or light signal) [condition: Where the health and safety of persons may be endangered by a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery or a related product] [REG, Annex III, 1.7.1.2]
[31] self-propelled machinery travelling function — requiresMeasure — an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device (an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device) [condition: Where safety so requires, in the event of a failure of the main device, or in the absence of the energy supply needed to actuate the main device] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.3]
[32] category of machinery or related product — listedIn — Annex I, Part A (annex i, part a) [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[33] simultaneous manoeuvring with collision risk — requiresMeasure — fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided (fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided) [condition: Where several fixed or rail-mounted machinery or related products can be manoeuvred simultaneously in the same place, with risks of collision] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.6]
[34] self-propelled machinery — requiresMeasure — an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device (an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device) [condition: Where safety so requires, in the event of a failure of the main device, or in the absence of the energy supply needed to actuate the main device] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[35] moving parts — requiresMeasure — fitted with guards or protective devices (fitted with guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.7]
[36] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[37] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — EU type-examination (module B) (eu type-examination (module b)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[38] control systems — addressesRisk — hazardous situations (hazardous situations) [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[39] mode selector — requiresMeasure — prevent any operation of hazardous functions by voluntary or involuntary action on the machine's sensors (prevent any operation of hazardous functions by voluntary or involuntary action on the machine's sensors) [condition: If, for certain operations, the machinery must be able to operate with a guard displaced or removed and/or a protective device disabled] [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.5]
[40] remote controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — designed and constructed in such a way that it will respond only to signals from the intended control units (designed and constructed in such a way that it will respond only to signals from the intended control units) [DIR, Annex I, 3.3]
[41] protective devices, control system design — requiresMeasure — Protective devices must be designed and incorporated into the control system (protective devices must be designed and incorporated into the control system) [condition: in such a way that moving parts cannot start up while within the operator's reach, persons cannot reach moving parts while moving, and absence or failure of a component prevents starting or stops the moving parts] [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.3]
[42] remote-controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — appropriate means to signal its movements (appropriate means to signal its movements) [condition: under normal conditions of use, exposes persons to the risk of impact or crushing] [REG, Annex III, 3.6.1]
[43] safety components — listedIn — Annex V (annex v) [DIR, Art. 2]
[44] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — internal production control (module A) (internal production control (module a)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[45] combined machinery or related product — addressesRisk — Risks related to a combined machinery or related product (risks related to a combined machinery or related product) [condition: Where the machinery or related product is intended to carry out several different operations with manual removal of the piece between each operation] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.5]
[46] safety components — listedIn — Annex II (annex ii) [REG, Art. 7(1)]
[47] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) (conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[48] ride-on self-propelled machinery — requiresMeasure — appropriate protective structure (appropriate protective structure) [condition: if its size allows] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.4]
[49] self-propelled machinery with ride-on driver — requiresMeasure — appropriate protective structure (appropriate protective structure) [condition: unless this increases the risk] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.3]
[50] human-machine interface — requiresMeasure — adapting the human-machine interface (adapting the human-machine interface) [REG, Annex III, 1.1.6]
[51] Driver — definedAs — operator responsible for the movement (operator responsible for the movement) [condition: may be transported by the machinery, on foot, or guide it by remote control] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[52] Supervisor — definedAs — a person responsible for the supervision of autonomous mobile machinery (a person responsible for the supervision of autonomous mobile machinery) [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[53] Supervisory function — definedAs — remote non permanent surveillance (remote non permanent surveillance) [condition: by a device receiving information or alerts and giving limited orders] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[54] stationary machinery — requiresMeasure — a parking device (a parking device) [condition: Where safety so requires] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[55] supervisory function — requiresMeasure — only allow actions to stop and to start remotely the machinery (only allow actions to stop and to start remotely the machinery) [condition: only when the supervisor can see directly or indirectly the machine’s movement and working area and the protective devices are operational] [REG, Annex III, 3.2.4]
[56] machinery without active supervisory function — requiresMeasure — shall not be able to operate (shall not be able to operate) [condition: If the supervisory function is not active] [REG, Annex III, 3.2.4]
[57] 2.3(b) ejection of workpieces — addressesRisk — risk of ejection of workpieces (risk of ejection of workpieces) [condition: where the machinery is likely to be used in conditions involving the risk of ejection of workpieces or parts of them] [DIR, Annex I, 2.3]
[58] 2.3(c) tool running down — addressesRisk — risk of contact with the tool (risk of contact with the tool) [condition: if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down] [DIR, Annex I, 2.3]
[59] category of machinery or related product not fulfilling points (a) to (d) — listedIn — Annex I, Part B (annex i, part b) [condition: does not fulfil one or more of the conditions in points (a) to (d)] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[60] categories of machinery or related products — requiresProcedure — procedure referred to in Article 25(2) (procedure referred to in article 25(2)) [REG, Annex I, Part A]
[61] removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards — listedIn — 1. (annex I, part A, point 1) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 1]
[62] Annex I, Part A, point 2 essential requirement — requiresMeasure — Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices (guards for removable mechanical transmission devices) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 2]
[63] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (vehicle servicing lifts) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
[64] Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery — listedIn — 4. (annex I, part A, point 4) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 4]
